document.title: Grow your email list

source.badge_text_exact: UPGRADEUpgrade required: This feature requires upgrading your plan to access.
source.description_exact: Collect emails on Instagram with a freebie offer
source.preview_text_exact:
Instagram
Grow your email list
Business value
We’ve got bad news and good news. Bad news: You don't own your Instagram follower list. Good news: you do own your email list. So, it’s a particularly good idea to add your IG audience to a channel you do have much control over, where you can reach more of them, more often.
How does it work?

You’ll hook followers by offering them a freebie and then collect their email addresses right in the DMs!

So if anything happens to your IG account, and you can’t reach as many of your followers as you once did, you’ll still have a way to reach out!

rendered_totals_exact.matching: Trigger -> initial email. Initial success -> ebook. Initial expiration -> reminder email. Reminder success -> same ebook. Empty action-on-reply and final timeout ports visible.

graph_integrity.limitation: Original graph is not exposed. Draft edges use visible navigation identity; no hidden IDs or server export.

json_exact.control: Save Response to a Custom Field
json_exact.account_choices: Not retained: no selected template dependency; unrelated account field names excluded.

selection.choose_when: Use a DM ebook offer requiring email, then a 23-hour no-response reminder that asks for email again.
selection.avoid_when: Do not treat the reminder as a generic follow-up or the default opt-in as evidence of legal consent.

safety.delivery_limit: No Set Live or send action. Scoped 0 runs before trigger removal and n/a list metrics are not account-wide no-delivery proof.

gaps: Original server settings and IDs were not exported. Clone defaults are not asserted to equal source defaults.
Runtime was not tested because execution is forbidden; this is separate from settings completeness.
All existing node defaults were opened. Shared options are evidence-matched; exhaustive alternative node-type conversion is not proven.
